title: What Makes a Latent Space Shared? Direct and Recoverable Compatibility in Motion VAEs
abstract: arXiv:2610.17376v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A shared latent space is often assumed to make representations from different schemas directly interchangeable, yet sharing parameters, dimensionality, or a prior does not determine how corresponding instances are expressed in latent coordinates. We show that this assumption conflates recoverable correspondence, direct compatibility, and decoder reuse. In a controlled multi-schema motion VAE on HumanML3D, even identical inputs yield only $5.9$--$17.7\%$ raw Recall@1 and $0.221$--$0.484$ paired-token cosine, despite correspondence being almost perfectly recoverable after linear calibration. Cycle consistency strengthens recoverability but still leaves direct retrieval and token agreement near zero. In contrast, only $64$ paired clips raise raw Recall@1 to $88.4$--$90.3\%$ and token cosine to approximately $0.82$, making most post-hoc alignment unnecessary, although crossed decoding remains substantially worse than native reconstruction. W

translated_title: 什么使潜在空间真正共享？运动VAE中的直接兼容性与可恢复兼容性
translated_abstract: 共享潜在空间通常被假设能使来自不同模式的表示直接互换，然而共享参数、维度或先验分布并不能决定对应实例在潜在坐标中的表达方式。我们证明这一假设混淆了可恢复的对应关系、直接兼容性和解码器复用三个概念。在HumanML3D数据集上受控的多模式运动VAE实验中，即使输入完全相同，原始Recall@1也仅为5.9%–17.7%，配对token余弦相似度仅为0.221–0.484，尽管经过线性校准后对应关系几乎可以完美恢复。循环一致性增强了可恢复性，但直接检索和token一致性仍接近于零。相比之下，仅需64个配对片段就能将原始Recall@1提升至88.4%–90.3%，token余弦相似度提升至约0.82，使得大多数事后对齐变得不再必要，尽管交叉解码仍明显逊色于原生重建。
tldr: 该研究揭示了共享潜在空间的假设混淆了可恢复对应、直接兼容性和解码器复用三个概念，并证明仅需64个配对片段即可实现高效跨模式对齐，远优于事后线性校准或循环一致性训练。
en_tdlr: This study disentangles the conflated notions of recoverable correspondence, direct compatibility, and decoder reuse in shared latent spaces, demonstrating that just 64 paired clips achieve efficient cross-schema alignment, far outperforming post-hoc linear calibration or cycle-consistency training.
